demo.demoDataDesc: The analysis below shows example decks with sample statistics. Real analysis is calculated from your actual battle history after signup - including win rates, trophy changes, deck performance, and personalized AI coaching based on your games.

aiInsights.hogCycle: Your Musketeer positioning is excellent for defense. Consider using Ice Golem to kite enemy troops while your Hog connects for extra damage. Fireball value can be improved by waiting for medium-sized pushes.
aiInsights.golemBeatdown: Strong beatdown execution! Focus on building massive pushes in double elixir. Your Lightning timing against Inferno Tower is crucial. Consider baiting out defensive buildings before committing your Golem in single elixir.
aiInsights.logBait: Excellent spell baiting! Your Princess placements force Log usage effectively. Focus on Rocket cycling in overtime when ahead. Time your Goblin Barrel predictions better against opponents who telegraph their spell usage patterns.
aiInsights.xbowSiege: Patient X-Bow placements show discipline. Your defensive Tesla timing needs refinement—place it 1 tile away from the river to pull tanks. In bad matchups, focus on defensive X-Bow and Fireball chip damage rather than forcing connections.

serviceDescription.title: Service Description
serviceDescription.content: AI Royale is an AI-powered analytics tool for Clash Royale. We provide deck analysis, battle insights, and strategic recommendations based on game data obtained through the official Clash Royale API.

dataProcessing.title: Data Processing
dataProcessing.content:
AI Royale exclusively processes game-related data obtained through the official Clash Royale API. This includes: player statistics, battle history, deck compositions, card levels, and trophy counts.

We do NOT access, process, or store any sensitive personal data. We only use your email address for authentication purposes.

aiDisclaimer.title: AI Disclaimer
aiDisclaimer.content:
All analyses, predictions, and recommendations provided by AI Royale are for informational purposes only.

AI-generated outputs are NOT guaranteed to be 100% accurate. The AI provides suggestions based on patterns and game data, but actual game outcomes depend on many factors including player skill, timing, and opponent behavior.

You should use AI recommendations as guidance, not as guaranteed strategies.

liability.content:

Fittechs Yazılım Anonim Şirketi is not responsible for any incorrect analyses or predictions provided by the AI.

privacy.introduction: This Privacy Policy explains how AI Royale handles your data. We are committed to protecting your privacy and being transparent about our data practices.

noSensitiveData.title: Data We Do NOT Collect
noSensitiveData.content:
• We do NOT collect or process sensitive personal data
• We do NOT access your device's personal information, contacts, or location
• We do NOT store payment card details (payments are handled by third-party processors)
• We do NOT collect any data beyond what is necessary for the service
• We do NOT sell, share, or monetize your data in any way

dataWeCollect.title: Data We Collect
dataWeCollect.content:
• Email address: Used solely for account authentication and password recovery
• Clash Royale Player Tag: Used to fetch your game statistics from the official Clash Royale API
• Game data: Player statistics, battle history, deck compositions, card levels - all publicly available through Supercell's official API
• Usage data: Basic analytics to improve our service

howWeUseData.title: How We Use Data
howWeUseData.content:
Game statistics are processed solely to provide AI-powered analysis and coaching recommendations. Your data is used to:

• Generate personalized deck recommendations
• Analyze your battle performance
• Provide strategic coaching insights
• Track your progress over time

We do not use your data for advertising or marketing purposes.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content:
• Account data: Retained while your account is active
• Game statistics: Cached temporarily (5-30 minutes) for performance
• Chat history: Retained for 30 days, then automatically deleted
• You can request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content:
AI Royale uses the following third-party services:

• Supercell Clash Royale API: To fetch game data
• Authentication provider: For secure login
• Cloud infrastructure: For data storage and processing

All third-party services are contractually bound to protect your data.

privacy.complianceSubtitle: AI Royale complies with global data protection regulations

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliance (European Union)
gdpr.content:
AI Royale complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for users in the European Economic Area.

Under GDPR, you have the following rights:

• Right of Access: Request a copy of your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a portable format
• Right to Object: Object to processing based on legitimate interests

To exercise these rights, contact us at the address below. We will respond within 30 days.

ccpa.title: CCPA Compliance (California, USA)
ccpa.content:
AI Royale complies with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) for California residents.

Under CCPA, California residents have the right to:

• Know what personal information is collected
• Know whether personal information is sold or disclosed
• Say no to the sale of personal information
• Access their personal information
• Request deletion of personal information
• Equal service and price (non-discrimination)

We do NOT sell your personal information to third parties. To submit a CCPA request, contact us at the address below.

kvkk.title: KVKK Compliance (Turkey)
kvkk.content:
AI Royale complies with Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK - Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu).

As a data controller, Fittechs Yazılım Anonim Şirketi processes your data in accordance with KVKK principles. You have the right to:

• Learn whether your personal data is being processed
• Request information about processing activities
• Request correction or deletion of your data
• Object to processing and request restriction

For KVKK-related requests, please contact us at the address below.
